title: Felix and the Debt
author: Lior Vane
blurb: Noor Okonkwo, a private security contractor guarding clients nobody trusts, has spent seven years following rules that keep getting rewritten. But when a dead handler sends a meeting invitation for tomorrow, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now he must get the truth past three governments and one assassin, and time is already running out.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
